entries.title: I Corinthians 1:1
segments: Paul, a called apostle of Jesus Christ through [the] will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:2
segments: to the church of God which is in Corinth, to those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called-out saints, with all those in every place who call on the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:3
segments: Grace [be] to you, and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:4
segments: I thank my God always on your behalf [for] the grace of God given you in Jesus Christ,

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:5
segments: that in everything you are enriched by Him, [in] all speech and in all knowledge;

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:6
segments: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you;

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:7
segments: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:8
segments: He shall also confirm you to [the] end, [that you may be] blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:9
segments: God [is] faithful, by whom you were called to [the] fellowship of His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:10
segments: But I exhort you, brothers, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, [that] you all speak the same thing and that there be no divisions among you; but that you be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:11
segments: For it has been declared to me concerning you, my brothers, by those of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:12
segments: But I say this, that every one of you says, I am of Paul, and I of Apollos, and I of Cephas, and I of Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:13
segments: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you, or were you baptized in the name of Paul?

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:14
segments: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:15
segments: lest any should say that I had baptized in my own name.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:16
segments: And I also baptized the household of Stephanas. Besides these, I do not know if I baptized any other.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:17
segments: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel; not in wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of no effect.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:18
segments: For the preaching of the cross is foolishness to those being lost, but to us being saved, [it is] the power of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:19
segments: For it is written, "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and I will set aside the understanding of the perceiving ones."

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:20
segments: Where [is the] wise? Where [is] the scribe? Where [is] the lawyer of this world? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:21
segments: For since, in the wisdom of God, the world [by] wisdom did not know God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save those who believe.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:22
segments: For the Jews ask for a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom;

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:23
segments: but we preach Christ crucified, to the Jews a stumbling block, and to the Greeks foolishness.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:24
segments: But to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:25
segments: Because the foolish thing of God is wiser [than] men, and the weak thing of God is stronger than men.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:26
segments: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many wise men according to the flesh [are called], not many mighty, not many noble.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:27
segments: But God has chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God has chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:28
segments: and God has chosen the base things of the world, and things which are despised, and things which are not, in order to bring to nothing things that are;

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:29
segments: so that no flesh should glory in His presence.

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:30
segments: But of Him you are in Christ Jesus, who of God is made to us wisdom and righteousness and sanctification and redemption;

entries.title: I Corinthians 1:31
segments: so that, according as it is written, "He who glories, let him glory in [the] Lord."
